decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that is still promoted on the home page and is very close to the firm's core dosimetry business, it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
The oncology risk management software extends the firm's established QA workflow offering and fits its strategic focus on integration, automation, and predictive support.
This CT image quality test phantom is adjacent to the firm's medical imaging QA activities and is too recently launched to be a likely withdrawal candidate absent clear failure signs.
Although more distant from the firm's historic offer, the mammography image quality phantom still fits the broader imaging QA direction, so withdrawal risk is only moderate.
The full field mammography test phantom is somewhat outside the firm's core but remains aligned with expansion into imaging QA instruments, making retention more likely than discontinuation.
Medical imaging quality assurance instruments support the firm's broadening product family and match its stated move toward integrated independent QA across modalities.
